interpretation: For every probability mixture supported on the exact 199-column pool, the ensemble-averaged balanced program-label mass distribution has TV distance strictly greater than the stated rational bound from the uniform balanced-label distribution. Equivalently this bounds the trace distance of the corresponding dephased program registers.
scope: Finite 199-column pool and fixed 2,113-row mixed-order design only. The sixth/eighth inventories are selected/cut, not complete. This is not a Choi-state trace-distance or channel diamond-distance bound, and it does not extend to arbitrary continuous physical couplings.
